services.name: Kayak Crew
services.desc: Create unforgettable memories on the water! Experience “Nashville’s Best Water Activity” with River Queen Voyages’ award-winning downtown kayak excursions. Enjoy the most unique views of Music City from the scenic Cumberland River, and get perfect photo ops with the vibrant city skyline. Our award-winning route, The Skyline, is a self-guided, one-way paddle on The Cumberland River from East Nashville to downtown. The route is 3 miles long and takes about 1 hour to complete on average, but we allow you up to 1.5 hours and encourage you to take your time and explore if you’d like! Book your unforgettable river experience today! River Queen Voyages is the #1 destination for river fun in Downtown Nashville. Since 2015, we’ve offered award-winning activities on the Cumberland River. We pride ourselves on offering safe, fun, and accessible opportunities to connect with nature and see Nashville from a different point of view. services.name: Stand Up Paddleboards
services.desc: In true River Queen fashion, these SUPs are better than any paddleboards you’ve ever known. Our brand-new Crescent K-Crafts offer all of the stability and comfort of a kayak, with the spacious deck and fun of a paddleboard! What’s even better? With their open layout and 350lb capacity, these SUPs have the perfect set up for bringing well-behaved kids or pets along with you on your paddle! Our Paddle Board offerings follow the same routing, scheduling, rules, and other general operations as our Kayaking excursions.
